body:
Real parser support for LO_Formal_Grammar_Phase_0_Complete.md's PCRE-oriented Pattern grammar (§19-29): Literal/Wildcard/Quantifier/Anchor/Alternation/CharacterClass+NCLASS+Range/Escaped/quantifiable PatternGroup, wired into Cond ::= Value MATCH Pattern via a new Match AST node. Verified against every one of the doc's own §20-29 worked examples via 10 new parser tests. Two real decisions flagged rather than silently resolved: bare-State pattern atoms not implemented (looks like an old base4-vector-pattern leftover); nested PatternGroups parse but aren't yet rejected despite §33. Found and fixed a real parser bug where GROUP's shared open/close token confused nested-vs-closing detection (insideGroup parameter). Parser-only -- no emitter support, no String values in LO yet, so nothing runs end-to-end yet. 41 tests total, GOWORK=off go build/vet/test ./... clean. commit 3dc6b90.

⚓ ☃
title: Pattern grammar parser (§19-29), wired into MATCH
